title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2610.22344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. translated_title: MLExpert：迈向自主机器学习工程的通用智能体模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在从辅助科学研究和工程扩展到自主开发和改进AI系统，推动“AI for AI”（AI4AI）作为通往递归自我改进（RSI）的路径。工作流驱动的机器学习工程（MLE）系统通过管理长期实验的复杂编排，为实现这一目标提供了实用路径；而近期的MLE系统采用模型主导的交互方式，使模型能够自主组织实验，并根据执行反馈调整优化策略。然而，每次实验的反馈反映的是此前多个决策的累积结果，而一次长期的MLE运行又包含许多此类代价高昂的实验。因此，训练过程必须从漫长的交互轨迹中筛选有用的监督信号，并从中间结果中学习。我们提出了一种面向自主长期MLE优化的后训练方法，并将其应用于训练MLExpert，一个（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向自主长期机器学习工程优化的后训练方法，通过从长交互轨迹中筛选有效监督信号并从中间结果中学习，训练出能够自主组织实验和调整优化策略的通用智能体模型MLExpert。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization that selects useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learns from intermediate outcomes, resulting in MLExpert, a generalist agentic model that autonomously organizes experiments and adapts optimization strategies.
